name: Store Product Filter
author: iqbalbary

sections.description:
Store Product Filter for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin designed to enhance the shopping experience on WooCommerce websites. With its intuitive filtering system, customers can quickly narrow down their search results based on various criteria such as price, category, attributes, and more. This plugin boosts user engagement by providing a seamless browsing experience, leading to increased conversion rates and customer satisfaction. Its efficient performance ensures rapid filtering without compromising website speed, making it an indispensable tool for online store owners looking to optimize their WooCommerce platform.

Key features:

  • Category Filter Widget
  • Price Filter Widget
  • Tag Filter Widget
